source_refs.note: X-Ray Imaging: a main subheading of 20.3 X-Rays, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 161-162.

blocks.text: Body se guzarte hue X-rays atoms se interaction kar ke energy khoti hain; is process ko attenuation (kamzor hona) kehte hain. X-rays atoms ko ionize kar sakti hain, yani electrons bahar nikal deti hain, aur isi tarah energy transfer (muntaqil) hoti hai. Material se guzarte hue X-ray beam ki intensity ahista ahista kam hoti hai, aur yeh kami exponential pattern (har barabar motai par barabar hissa kam) mein hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab formula I = I₀ xe^(−μx) chhapti hai, jis mein exponential ke saath ek extra x (thickness, motai) multiply (zarb) hai. Sahi formula I = I₀e^(−μx) hai: thickness x sirf power (exponent) mein aati hai.

items: I = material se guzarne ke baad intensity
x = material ki thickness (motai), metres mein
μ = attenuation coefficient (material aur X-ray ki energy par depend karta hai)

blocks.alt: Baen: thickness x ke saath intensity I = Io e^(-mu x) ke do curves; soft tissue (chhota mu) ahista aur haddi (bara mu) tezi se girti hai. Daen: oopar se X-rays tissue aur us ke andar haddi se guzarti hain; neeche film par haddi ki jagah safaid (bright) saya aur baqi film kaali hai.
blocks.caption: X-ray imaging mein attenuation aur contrast (hamari drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Haddi ka μ soft tissue se bohat zyada hai, is liye haddi mein se kam X-rays guzarti hain. Film par jahan kam X-rays pohanchti hain woh hissa safaid (bright) rehta hai. Isi farq se haddi aur tissue alag nazar aate hain, yani contrast banta hai.

Real-time X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy, yani chalti hui X-ray video) mein image intensifiers istemal hote hain. Yeh image ko bright kar ke dekhna aasan banate hain aur radiation exposure (mareez par radiation) kam karte hain. X-ray image mein contrast ka matlab hai ke mukhtalif tissues kitni clearly (saaf) alag pehchane ja sakte hain; contrast X-rays ki energy par depend karta hai. Hard X-rays (zyada energy) haddiyon ki image ke liye, aur soft X-rays (kam energy) breast jaise soft tissues ke liye behtar hain. Contrast media khaas substances (cheezein) hain jaise iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jo X-rays ko khoob absorb karti hain. Inhein injection se diya jata hai ya nigla jata hai taa ke body ke khaas hisse highlight (numayan) hon. Zyada atomic number ki wajah se yeh X-ray absorption barha kar un tissues ko saaf dikhati hain.

items: Heavy atoms mein inner shells ki transitions characteristic X-rays deti hain (Kα: E_L − E_K; Kβ: E_M − E_K).
X-ray tube: V se accelerate hue electrons, (K.E.)ₘₐₓ = Ve, tungsten target se takrate hain.
Continuous spectrum: bremsstrahlung; sab se chhoti wavelength λₘᵢₙ jahan Ve = hfₘₐₓ.
Attenuation: I = I₀e^(−μx); contrast media (iodine, barium) contrast barhate hain.
